svg.aria-label: Scatter of six hundred noisy per-sample targets against the noisy value, spread widely, with binned averages of those targets lying on the exact score curve of the three-level dataset
svg.text: DENOISING SCORE MATCHING: NOISY TARGETS, EXACT AVERAGE
Regression converges to the conditional mean of its target, and that mean is the score.
Deterministic simulation from the lab script on the three-level dataset; no network was trained. Bins are 0.25 wide.
